incident_time: 00:20 2022 SAUDI ARABIAN GRAND PRIX 24 - 27 March 2022 The Stewards have received a request from Scuderia AlphaTauri to allow car 22 to start the race despite failing to set a qualifying time in Q1. In accordance with Article 42.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, the Stewards grant permission for car 22, Yuki Tsunoda, to start the race, as the driver has set satisfactory times in practice at this Event. The car will be placed on the grid in accordance with Article 42.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
rules_referenced: Article 42.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
title: Decision Car 22 Failing To Set A Time In Qualifying
